According to last month's survey, patients wait an average of thirty-five minutes after their scheduled appointment, and that's our most common complaint. explanation: 患者の待ち時間の長さが最も多い苦情だと話している。

Currently, a single manager can approve payments of up to fifty thousand dollars. The auditors consider that too much authority for one person, and frankly, I agree. From now on, any payment above ten thousand dollars will require a second approval from the finance department. I realize this may slow things down a bit, particularly at the end of the month. I know some of you have concerns, so I've set aside time on Thursday afternoon to go through the new process.
